Message: These architecture-relevant resources are missing Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context: MyInstance (AWS::EC2::Instance). For each listed resource, add Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context. Set 'why' to the resource's purpose or design rationale. If the rationale is not documented, set 'gaps' to ["rationale not documented"] instead of guessing. Add 'must' as a list only for known constraints whose violation would break the system; otherwise omit it. Leave unlisted resources unchanged.

Rule.Description: Check for a machine-readable Metadata.com.aws.cloudformation.Context block on the template and on architecture-relevant resources. Incidental framework resources and subordinate types such as AWS::Logs::LogGroup are not expected to carry one.
Rule.ShortDescription: Template or architecture-relevant resource has no Context block
